title: COP31 enters extra day of talks amid fears over agreement
story: There are fears that the COP31 Climate
in Turkey could end without a deal as a

dispute over whether even to mention fossil fuels in the final agreement deepens. The talks in Antalya have now into gone into an extra day for negotiations, with the different sides as far apart as ever on fossil fuel inclusion. The draft text on the table this

is the one issued on Thursday, which dropped all explicit references to fossil fuels. Much of the frustration on the European side comes down to how little it is now asking of the countries opposing it to mention the transition away from fossil fuels. This frustration is being amplified also by the global acceptance now that warming is set to breach the 1.5 degrees Celsius limit set out in the Paris
ago, governments agreed to contribute to a global effort to move away from fossil fuels in their energy systems.
